title: 时装品牌市场调研分析
titleEn: Luxury Fashion Brand Market Research Analysis
subtitle: 品牌调研小组课程作业
description: 小组完成多组时装品牌深度调研，聚焦品牌定位、视觉风格与受众分析，完成整本调研报告整合输出。
descriptionEn: A group research on multiple fashion brands focusing on brand positioning, visual style and audience analysis, with integrated research report delivered.
concept: 对标当下轻奢时装赛道，剖析品牌差异化运营逻辑、视觉体系与消费受众，完成专业化课程调研复盘。
conceptEn: Analyze differentiated operation logic, visual system and target audiences of luxury fashion brands to complete professional research summary.
roleDetail: 负责前期调研方案撰写、时装品牌选题敲定，独立完成内外品牌专项调研，收尾统筹全文整理、视觉版式风格统一。
roleDetailEn: Responsible for preliminary research scheme design and brand selection, completing NEIWAI brand research independently, and integrating content to unify overall report style.
